messages:
marta: Bringing up rwdx-3b-v2 int4 on the longctx suite. Quick heads-up: subtle token shift after ~12k tokens, KV hashes diverge between host and float reference. Posting minimal repro + logs.

sam: Can you paste the repro and the exact config you used?

marta: Repro snippet and observed lines below:
```
seed=42
prompt_len=12800
model=rwdx-3b-v2-int4
quant=per_channel_asym_4bit
rotary_mode=dynamic_rope
obs: gen[12790..12799] expected '...,' but got '...?'
kv_hash_host=0x3f1a2
kv_hash_ref=0x3f1b7
```

jules: Did you try with rotary_scale=1.0 vs our dynamic interpolation? We had an off-by-one when the phase table was resized. Could be exponent rounding.

marta: I ran two modes so far: `rotary_mode=linear_scale` and `rotary_mode=dynamic_rope`. Linear_scale stays stable to ~8k then drifts. Dynamic re-aligns some heads but introduces softmax spikes near wrap.

kai: Try `cache_strict_mode=true` (no implicit wrap dedupe) and capture `kv_index_dump` at the end. If it's a wrapping bug you'll see duplicate key indices.

marta: Ran with cache_strict_mode=true, output excerpt:
```
layer:17 pos:12000 kv_indices:[12000,12001,..., -wrap-> 0,1]
checksum_layer17_host=0x7b4c
checksum_layer17_ref=0x7b9f
```
Looks like a mismatch right where the indices wrap.

nora: Also double-check quant cfg: per-channel vs per-tensor and clip method. Some asymmetric clips interact poorly with accumulation at long ranges. Which quant profile?

marta: per-channel asymmetric, clip=scaled_mse, blocksize=32. I can re-run per-tensor symmetric to compare.

infra-bot: benchmark queued: job 8349 (longctx/quant/kv-diff)

sam: We should also run float16 baseline to determine whether divergence is quantization or RoPE wrapping. If float16 matches ref, it's quantization. If float16 diverges too, it's rope/cache.

marta: Quick PPL / lev summary from local runs:
- 2k: host=float16=9.3 ref=9.2 lev=0.02
- 8k: host=int4=10.1 ref=10.0 lev=0.03
- 12k: host=int4=12.5 ref=10.3 lev=0.21  <-- divergence window starts ~12000 tokens

jules: That jump screams cache index misalignment. Our tiled caching layer may be folding indices incorrectly when prefill spans shards. Add `dump_prefill_segments=true` and `dump_kv_pairs=true`.

kai: If it's index folding, you'll see repeated keys in `dump_kv_pairs` (same key id mapped to multiple absolute positions). Also try `tiled_cache=false` to force contiguous KV.

marta: Will run tiled_cache=false and tiled_cache=true with dumps on both. Also will try disabling rotary interpolation (`rotary_mode=raw_indices`).

nora: Good. If raw_indices fixes it, it's probably phase scaling. If raw_indices still diverges, then caching wrap is the main suspect.

marta: Running both now, ETA ~30m. Attaching the job id when ready. thx :thumbsup:

infra-bot: job 8349 completed: artifacts uploaded to s3://rwd-infer/harvest/8349/; summary.csv + kv_dumps/ included.

marta: Uploaded artifacts look like the tiled_cache=true case produced duplicated key ranges at the wrap boundary. I'll open a small repro harness to isolate.

sam: Awesome. If you can extract a minimal failing trace (layer, pos, kv_index pair) we'll add a unit test in the tiled cache layer.

marta: Will do, posting the minimal trace in the ticket. Thanks all.
